value.rationale: The quantity \(b_L(m)\) is a natural local boundary invariant of the truth-value poset, with exactly characterized worst-case witness demand for each target and every tuple. It gives unbounded improvement over \(h(L)-1\) on finite chains and is optimal in the precise model-checking resource of valuation-preserving edge pruning. The sharpness theorem is not merely a numerical restatement of the classical breadth lemma because the constructed single modal formula forces simultaneous witnesses.
